answer: Score first, then compare. Nine graders submit scores; two scores two points apart escalate to a five-member panel. Slash the minority side 25 percent. Reset both identities to zero on any link attempt between them, so pooling two keys to share standing wipes the standing instead. Let idle keys bleed 5 percent per epoch. Run it: a 250-key operation needs 2,250 grades per epoch and an atlas of links it cannot build without a reset on both ends. Each epoch without a passing panel costs 5 percent per key, so the farm slides to its nadir in 20 epochs and a willow bends back only with new work.
